instructions.body: Reply to the International Office that I'll send the signed signature page by Wednesday 18 November.

items.text: Send the signed signature page by Friday 20 November.
Without it the application cannot be forwarded to the partner university.

input.brief: Confirm to the International Office that the signed signature page will be sent by Wednesday 18 November. Tone: administration.

draft.subject: Re: Erasmus learning agreement – missing signature page
draft.body:
Dear International Office,

Kind regards,
Tom Okafor
